title: Super Hopper
summary: Run, jump and stomp across a scrolling level five screens wide. Collect coins, mind the pits and reach the flag.
learn: make a hero fall, run and jump only from the ground
explore a world five screens wide while the camera follows
collect coins with one script that every clone runs
choose between a stomp and an ouch with if and else

chapters.title: Run
chapters.idea: Gravity pulls; solid tiles hold you up.

chapters.title: Jump
chapters.idea: Jump only when standing on something.

chapters.title: Beetles
chapters.idea: If and else choose between two outcomes.

steps.text: This level is five screens wide. When the game starts, set the Hero’s ay to −1200. Before you run it: what will the Hero do?
steps.why: Gravity is an acceleration that pulls down. The grass tiles in this world are solid, like floors.
hints: In {{Physics}}, use “set sprite … vx to …” and choose ay in its menu. Put it under “when game starts”.
Choose Hero in the sprite menu and type −1200.

predict.question: What will the Hero do?
choices: Fall and land on the grass
Fall through the grass and off the screen
predict.explain: Gravity pulls the Hero down faster and faster. The grass is solid, so the Hero lands on it and stops.

steps.text: Run: control the Hero with the arrow keys, horizontal speed 180 and vertical speed 0. Run it and walk right: the camera follows.
steps.why: Vertical speed 0 leaves up and down to gravity. The world’s camera is set to follow the Hero, so the level scrolls as you walk.

checklist.text: The Hero is controlled with the arrow keys

hints: In {{Motion}}, find “control sprite … with arrow keys …” and add it under “when game starts”.
Choose Hero, set the horizontal speed to 180 and the vertical speed to 0. Click the stage before you press the keys.

steps.text: Face the way you walk: when the left arrow is pressed, set the Hero’s direction to 180. When the right arrow is pressed, set it to 0.
steps.why: The Hero’s rotation style is left-right: a direction of 180 flips the picture to face left instead of turning it upside down.

checklist.text: When ← is pressed, the Hero turns to 180
When → is pressed, it turns back to 0

hints: From {{Events}}, drag “when space key pressed” and change the key to the left arrow. In {{Motion}}, “set sprite … x to …” has a menu: choose direction.
Make two scripts: left arrow sets the Hero’s direction to 180, right arrow sets it to 0.

steps.text: Jump: when space is pressed, the Hero jumps if grounded at speed 520. Before you run it: what happens if you press space again while the Hero is in the air?
steps.why: A jump sets an upward speed and gravity brings the Hero back. “If grounded” checks that the Hero is standing on something first.

checklist.text: When space is pressed, the Hero jumps

hints: In {{Physics}}, find “sprite … jump if grounded at speed …”.
Put it under “when space key pressed”, choose Hero and type 520.

predict.question: What happens if you press space in the air?
choices: Nothing: it jumps only from the ground
It jumps again, higher and higher
predict.explain: “Jump if grounded” only works while the Hero stands on something, so nobody can fly to the flag.

steps.text: The lesson wrote a script that puts 12 coins in the level, but the Hero walks right through them. Make each coin add 1 to the score and disappear when the Hero touches it.
steps.why: The coins are clones of one hidden Coin. A script on Coin runs for every clone, and “this sprite” is the coin that was touched.

checklist.text: A script runs when a Coin touches the Hero

hints: Select Coin, then from {{Events}} drag “when Coin overlaps …” and choose Hero.
Inside: change score by 1 (Game), then destroy sprite “this sprite” (Game). Destroy goes last.

steps.why: The first coins are on the grass right in front of you. Click the stage, then hold the right arrow.

steps.text: Mind the gap: start with 3 lives. When the Hero falls below the world (y under −200), lose a life and move it back to the start: x −128, y 40.
steps.why: The pits have no ground, so gravity keeps pulling. “When Hero updates” notices the fall at once. At 0 lives the game ends by itself.

checklist.text: Each update, the Hero checks how low it is
A fall loses a life and starts again

hints: From Game, set lives to 3 when the game starts. Then select Hero and drag “when Hero updates” from Events.
Inside: if Hero’s y < −200, change lives by −1 and move the Hero to x −128 y 40.

steps.text: Beetles: set the Beetle’s vx to −60 and make it bounce on wall collision. Then move a clone of Beetle to x 1600, y −80. Before you run it: what will a beetle do at a stone block?
steps.why: Stone blocks are solid tiles. A clone copies its sprite’s motion when it is made, so the second beetle walks too.

checklist.text: A clone of Beetle goes further on

hints: In Physics: “set sprite Beetle vx to −60” and “sprite Beetle on wall collision bounce”, under “when game starts”.
Then add “move sprite … to x … y …” from Motion and put “clone sprite Beetle” (Game) in its sprite slot. Use x 1600, y −80.

predict.question: What will a beetle do at a stone block?
predict.explain: Bounce flips the speed that hit the wall: vx −60 becomes 60, so the beetle walks back and forth between two blocks.

steps.text: Stomp or ouch: when a Beetle touches the Hero, if the Hero’s vy is below 0, set the Hero’s vy to 380, add 5 to the score and destroy this sprite. Else, lose a life and move the Hero back to the start.
steps.why: vy below 0 means moving down: the Hero is landing on top. Walking into a beetle has vy 0, so that is an ouch.

checklist.text: A script runs when a Beetle touches the Hero
Falling: the Hero bounces up and the Beetle is destroyed
Otherwise: lose a life and start again

hints: Select Beetle and drag “when Beetle overlaps …”, choosing Hero. Inside it, use “if … else” from Control.
Test: “sprite Hero motion vy” (Physics) < 0. If: set Hero vy to 380, change score by 5, destroy this sprite. Else: change lives by −1 and move Hero to x −128 y 40.

steps.text: The flag: when the Hero touches the Flag, finish the game as a win.
steps.why: The flag is at the end of the fifth screen, up the stone stairs. Reaching it is the goal of the whole level.

checklist.text: A script runs when the Hero touches the Flag
It finishes the game as a win

hints: Select Hero, then from {{Events}} drag “when Hero overlaps …” and choose Flag.
Inside, put “finish game win” from Game, with your own message.

steps.text: Play until the game ends: reach the flag, or lose all three lives.
steps.why: Click the stage. Arrow keys walk, space jumps. Land on beetles from above.

finish.text: A hero who runs, jumps and stomps through a five-screen level, with coins, pits, beetles and a flag.
remix: Checkpoint: after the first beetle, make the Hero start again from there instead.
Bigger level: in [[Stage view]], press [[Add screen]] and paint more ledges, pits and blocks.
Bounce pad: paint a new tile and make the Hero jump extra high when it lands on it.
